title: gammacombo/gammacombo: LHCb-PAPER-2026-058
description: Release of the GammaCombo code used for LHCb-PAPER-2026-058, "Progress in measurements of the CKM angle gamma and charm mixing at LHCb". The LHCb-specific inputs are in a separate private sub-package (gitlab.cern.ch/gammacombo/gammacombo), which is not included here. The D→Kπππ inputs enter as a Gaussian constraint derived from a standalone pre-combination of LHCb, BESIII and CLEO results, performed with the k3pi-combiner package (https://gitlab.cern.ch/lhcb-b2oc/CommonAnalysisTools/k3pi-combiner, LHCb-internal).
